body:
The previous demo did not transfer the real coach/athlete planning and review loop. This adds a no-login static demo that imports the current calendar/editor/detail/discussion and messaging/draft components, with a closed synthetic data adapter, deterministic running/trail fixtures, tab-scoped refresh persistence and confirmed reset. Coach planning, athlete logging/reply, review/adjustment, library/copy/reschedule, matching and unread/draft state remain coherent within one browser tab.

Current immutable static preview: https://ultra-os-tb77-fbct852gc-tadschweizers-projects.vercel.app
Runtime source: 54f2ab181848baf022c2fc59ce0c5c492f00da1d
Deployment: dpl_EtjWEJQQ4gY6xA7UW7aFvf8SeB2B (READY, target=null, aliases=[]).
Authoritative source base: fa8ebe2b377784007b4a40b4e982f92a11224075.

Independent exact-build QA on runtime 54f2ab records limited PASS for the agreed synthetic daily-coaching demo scope, October 10, 2026, 01:47:49–01:53:51 UTC. F4/F5 clear at 1440/390/320px; F1–F3 smoke and the core coach/athlete loop pass. The reviewer independently matched all four served file byte lengths/hashes to the cb3136fd manifest and observed zero API/external requests or JavaScript errors. Exact unmodified report and original ZIP are preserved in docs/demo-evidence/independent-54f2ab (ZIP SHA-256 B13707F02659FE9C08325045EBA5197B596FFF0C046028D49E913E0B2C6155CB). All earlier failures/dates remain. This is scoped acceptance, not full Threshold parity.

Validation: 17/17 adapter/helper tests; full local browser 21/21 (1.0m); full hosted browser 21/21 (1.2m); production authentication regression 432/432; final static and Next builds pass. Hosted tests verify JS/CSS SHA-256 matches local artifacts, strict connect-src none, protected API paths 404 and no demo page API/external requests. Exact CI status is separate from these local/hosted results. No lint script exists.

Production authentication, protected API handlers, service configuration, providers and database schema are unchanged. Full library prescription metadata preservation is demo-only adapter storage; this does not fix the narrower production library persistence schema. No seeder, secrets, provider calls, email/payment actions or live-domain promotion are included. Messaging/imports are explicitly local simulations; no actual delivery or simultaneous participant concurrency. Wider product exclusions are documented in DEMO_PARITY_MATRIX.md. Physical-phone/Safari/Firefox, measured mechanical work/kJ retention, production library persistence/production regression and other report-listed branches were not run by independent QA. Implementer results above are separate self-verification.

Reproduce: cd coach-demo; npm ci; npm run build; npm test; npm run test:browser. Launch with npx vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173. Use DEMO_BASE_URL above to run hosted checks and DEMO_CHROME for an alternate installed Chromium. See DEMO_VERIFICATION.md, DEMO_QA_FIXES.md, coach-demo/preview-identity.json and docs/demo-evidence for mappings, steps, hashes, screenshots and raw outputs.

Documentation-only follow-up records scoped acceptance; the runtime and frozen preview are unchanged and no manual redeployment is performed. PRODUCT_EXECUTION_ROADMAP.md also queues UX-006 in M7: an iPhone-style conversation list/thread, clear sender bubbles/unread state and mobile composer, preserving persistent drafts/retries/delivery/read behavior and coach-athlete context. Proposed after demo stabilization and before a polished coach presentation if the user chooses; separate from P0-015 reliability acceptance. No redesign is implemented.

Keep draft and unmerged. Do not promote to production.
